title: events/journald: omit timestamp from log output
body:
Omit redundant timestamps from event log messages dispatched to journald.

As discussed in #29835 and recommended by @Luap99, journald already records native timestamps for each entry. Embedding an extra timestamp in the log message body creates clutter and redundancy in journal output.

The timestamp prefix is removed specifically from the string dispatched to journald, while preserving timestamps in the `podman events` CLI output.

Fixes: #29835
